race.description: The Wcdc Blood, Sweat & Beers Hcp (58+)
race.comment: IN SITU (2) stands out as the horse to beat after a win and a neck defeat as the favorite, with a wide run making the loss easier to forgive. His 1200m record is the strongest in the race, and Natasha Faithfull's two wins from three rides on him add solid support. CHAMPEZE (8) is a genuine threat, having beaten IN SITU last time despite a poor start and being stalled near the 200m. Her two wins from six tries at this track and distance lend her performance credibility. DEEP DISCRETION (4) returns after eight months, raising concerns about race fitness, but her three wins and four placings from seven starts at this track and distance can't be overlooked; she also has a BM58+ win and a close second in her last prep. SAFE HUSTLE (6) may lack a winning edge, but his fourth behind Luckee Floran last start was decent, and he has local 1200m experience to seek a minor result. CLEVER COMBAT (10) is next best.
